title: Ellmi's Zauberwelt Ellmau
highlights: 4,000 m² magical mountain adventure park atop the summit of Hartkaiser
Captivating riddle rally through the enchanted forest for children
Observation tower and panoramic trail showcasing glorious views of the Wilder Kaiser
Comfortable ascent via the modern 10-seater Hartkaiserbahn gondola
kurzbeschreibung: Ellmi's Zauberwelt on the Hartkaiser in Ellmau is a 4,000 m² alpine children's adventure park set against the backdrop of the Wilder Kaiser.
beschreibung:
Magical Adventure on the Hartkaiser

Set on the 1,555-metre-high Hartkaiser in Ellmau lies Ellmi's Zauberwelt, a lovingly designed adventure park for the whole family. The story of Ellmi the magic frog whisks young and older explorers into a realm full of forest spirits, goblins, and hidden mysteries.

Play and Wonder with Kaiser Panoramas

Climbing castles, water play features, treehouses, and an extensive nature discovery trail invite children to play and explore. From the panoramic sun terraces of the Bergrestaurant Hartkaiser, visitors enjoy perhaps the most striking view of the towering rocky massif of the Wilder Kaiser.
